description: Fetch a compact snapshot of an American Default economic indicator by slug. Returns latest value, unit, frequency, direction, pre-computed aggregates (period averages, extremes, sustained runs), editorial prose (when available), and canonical APA / MLA / Chicago / news-copy citations. Raw historical series is NOT included — use https://americandefault.org/api/indicators/{slug}.json for the full data. Slug examples: 'the-buffer' (personal savings rate), 'mortgage-delinquency-rate', 'initial-unemployment-claims-sa'.

slug.description: The kebab-case indicator slug (e.g., 'the-buffer' for personal savings rate, 'mortgage-delinquency-rate', 'initial-unemployment-claims-sa'). 120 indicators available. Use `search_indicators` first to discover which slug corresponds to a concept.
slug.title: Slug
